summary: Backend-only testing of alpha-fit API (24 tests, 100% pass after one bug fix). Tested auth (register/login/admin/me), onboarding + AI plan generation, current plan retrieval, full workout session lifecycle (start/resume/active/log-set/update-progress/complete + badge), AI Coach chat (gpt-5.2 via Emergent key), adjust-plan (versioned), Stripe LIVE checkout creation + payment_transactions persistence + status retrieval, and all admin endpoints (stats, members, grant/revoke premium, delete, 403 for non-admin).

minor.issue: Stripe LIVE checkout works but webhook signing secret (STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET) is not set in .env so the webhook endpoint will accept unsigned payloads in fallback mode (security risk for production).
Returns 500 if LLM JSON parsing fails (no fallback like onboarding plan generation). Consider adding a fallback to keep UX resilient.

action_items: Optional: add fallback plan handling inside /api/coach/adjust-plan when LLM returns unparsable JSON (currently raises 500).
Optional: configure STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET for production-grade webhook verification.
Recommend: explicit ObjectId exclusion pattern at insert time everywhere (verified _id pop fix applied to start_session, generate_ai_plan, coach_adjust).
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: motor `insert_one` mutates the dict to add `_id` ObjectId. Three endpoints (sessions/start, generate_ai_plan, coach_adjust) returned that dict directly and FastAPI failed to JSON-encode ObjectId -> 500. Added `dict.pop('_id', None)` after each insert.
is_premium_active reads `premium_until`/`trial_until` as ISO strings; if a non-ISO/None value sneaks in it silently treats user as non-premium (currently safe but undefined behaviour).
/api/sessions/complete badge logic uses `user.get('badges', [])` from token-loaded user (could be stale if user has earned badges in another flow). Acceptable now but worth noting.
server.py is ~860 lines and approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into auth/coach/sessions/admin/payments routers for maintainability.

Payment-status returns open/unpaid because no card flow was completed. Test users accumulate in DB under TEST_ prefix; consider purging if running many iterations.
rca of the issue: TypeError: 'ObjectId' object is not iterable -> Motor's insert_one mutates the input dict, adding `_id: ObjectId(...)`. The endpoints returned the same dict directly to FastAPI's jsonable_encoder, which cannot serialize ObjectId. Fix: pop `_id` from the dict immediately after insert. Reproduction: POST /api/sessions/start (after onboarding) returned 500 with `ValueError: [TypeError("'ObjectId' object is not iterable"), ...]`. Mitigation applied and verified by re-running full test suite (24/24 pass).
